settings.title: How it plays
settings.content: Switch it on and set it down. Pounce rolls forward, backs up and turns on random paths, and its swinging tail lets it spin and dart off in a new direction.

settings.title: Safe play
settings.content:
• Play together and put the toy away after play.
  • Check the toy regularly and stop using it if any part is damaged.
